_what: do the baked ternary image and the GCP lane's on-the-fly solve resolve the same openfe/openmmtools/pymbar? The parity claim in CLAUDE.md §6 rests on this and it had never been measured.
sentence: PARITY HOLDS on openfe, openmmtools, pymbar — the image and the GCP spec resolve identical versions, so a leg produced on one and analysed on the other cannot move an MBAR number through a version difference.
